function.name: write_to_file
function.description: this function writes the text to any file format, make sure to get the format correct with the file_name, this is different from the scratchpad because it stores the text files of any format permenantly.

file_name.description: write the full file path here

function.name: read_file
function.description: Reads and returns the text contents of a specified file within the active project workspace. Use the exact relative_path string returned by the directory index (e.g., '/text.txt' or '/subfolder/script.py').

filename.description: The relative file path within the project directory to read (e.g., 'logs.txt' or '/subfolder/config.json').

function.name: edit_file_content
function.description: Searches for a specific text string inside a file and replaces it with new text within the active project workspace.

filename.description: The relative path of the file to edit (e.g., 'script.py' or '/subfolder/data.txt').

old_text.description: The exact target string currently inside the file that needs to be replaced.

new_text.description: The new replacement content string that will overwrite the old_text.

function.name: search_directory_index
function.description: with indexing it Explores, maps, or searches the active workspace directory. Run this tool with NO query (or null) if you are lost, need to understand the project structure, or want to locate files; this returns the entire recursive directory tree, listing all files, subdirectories, and lightweight code preview snippets. If you know what you are looking for, provide a query to filter files and paths by keyword.

query.description: The keyword, filename, folder name, or file extension to search for. OPTIONAL: Leave this completely empty or null to retrieve the entire project layout and map out the codebase.

function.name: scan_pattern
function.description: Recursively searches code files using regex grep. Returns matching lines with context lines before and after.

target_dir.description: Directory path to scan (defaults to active project directory).

pattern.description: Extended regular expression pattern to search for.

context_lines.description: Number of context lines before and after matches (default 3).
